messages:
Aisha: Kicking off AlturaHealth onboarding — first sync. Renewal flagged for 2027-11. Goal today: align stakeholders, success criteria, and 30/60 timeline. CC @Ravi and @Lena for tech/PM.
Ravi: I can own data ingest + schema work. Need a prod-ish sample dataset and S3 creds. If we get that, initial pipeline in ~2 weeks.
Lena (Altura): Hi all — we can provision a sandbox S3 by EOD Tue. Who should I share creds with? Also Altura wants SSO via Okta.
Aisha: Share creds to ravi@redwood or drop a private link in 1:1. @Marco can you take the SSO stream? :thumbsup:
Marco: I’ll own SSO. Need SP/IdP metadata + a list of test users. Estimate ~5 business days after we have metadata.
Ravi: One ask — customer target for chat latency is <300ms median. We should plan perf runs on candidate models (64-token bursts) and sanity-check batching. @Nina could help with profiling.
Nina (ML-Ops): Yep — send sample prompts + dataset. I’ll run a perf matrix (model x quant x batch) and put recommendations in the doc.
Aisha: Proposed success criteria:
- End-to-end sandbox flow (embeddings + chat) with sample dataset
- SSO enabled with >=5 test users
- Staging median latency <350ms
- Knowledge transfer + handoff session recorded
Everyone okay with that?
Lena (Altura): That looks right. Also need audit logs retention of 12 months for compliance — can Redwood support that? @Priya FYI.
Priya (Security): We support 12m retention on Private deployments; for Hosted we offer a retention add-on. I’ll detail options & pricing.
Aisha: Risks to call out:
- Delay in S3 creds (blocks ingest)
- Okta metadata issues (SSO delay)
- Over-aggressive quantization causing quality regression
Action items (owners + due dates):
- Ravi: request sample S3 link & schema (due Thu)
- Marco: request Okta metadata & create test users (due Fri)
- Nina: perf plan & first run (due next Wed)
- Priya: retention options + cost (due Mon)
I’ll set a weekly 30m cadence — Wed 10:00 PT. Works?
Ravi: Works for me.
Marco: Works.
Lena (Altura): Works — I’ll invite Altura product + infra to the invite.
Aisha: I’ll create the calendar invite and a Confluence onboarding checklist. Quick note — renewal exposure: projected seat uplift if usage >500k tokens/mo. I’m creating a renewal-risk ticket for finance to watch.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "AlturaHealth Onboarding - Weekly" Wed 10:00 PT starting 3776543840
Aisha: Thanks — I’ll post the checklist link here once it’s up.
Lena (Altura): One more thing — can we get an initial list of required roles for handoff (support, infra, PM)? I’ll prep attendees.
Aisha: Yes — will add a Roles section in the checklist (Support: @Support, Infra: Marco, PM: Lena).
Ravi: Adding a tiny config snippet we’ll need from Altura (sample):
```
S3_BUCKET=altura-sandbox
PREFIX=customer-data/
TEST_USER_PREFIX=altura-test-
```
Lena (Altura): Copy — will provision and DM creds to Ravi.
Aisha: Great. Next post: Confluence link + calendar invite. If anything urgent, ping me or drop in this thread. :rocket:
